title: Soul Feast #7: Intuition & Non-Physical Teachers
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the transformative nature of the new consciousness, which moves beyond the limits of the five senses and embraces a deeper awareness of non-physical reality.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the transformative nature of the new consciousness, which moves beyond the limits of the five senses and embraces a deeper awareness of non-physical reality. 

He introduces the role of intuition, which unlike in the old consciousness where it was seen as mere “hunches,” is now an essential guide for spiritual growth. 

This Soul Feast explains how our intuition acts as a gateway to non-physical Teachers – energetic guides who provide us with compassion and wisdom beyond the scope of our intellect.

Gary emphasizes the importance of approaching life from a place of love rather than fear, explaining that this choice fuels the creation of authentic power. 

He also explores how the Earth school, with its dualities and challenges, offers us opportunities to practice this awareness, using our experiences to move closer to our true spiritual purpose.

As you listen, you’ll learn practical ways to harness intuition in daily life, interact with non-physical Teachers, and align your actions with love.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (0:05): How moving beyond the five senses opens us to non-physical reality and spiritual growth.
  • (04:10): The role of non-physical Teachers in providing compassionate, wisdom-filled guidance for your spiritual journey.
  • (05:29): Why intuition is a vital connection to guidance, and how it differs from the “hunches” of the old consciousness.
  • (06:29): How to distinguish between love and fear in your intentions, and why this choice shapes your reality.
  • (17:00): Using your experiences in the Earth School for spiritual development and viewing life’s challenges as opportunities for growth, and learning to harness them to create authentic power.

Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Senses?  Learn how here.
